11	import '../cubit/account_settings_cubit.dart';
12	
13	/// Tela 6 — Configurações, Story 2.4's real build (Acceptance Criteria:
14	/// "shows only the biometric toggle — minimal, Epic 8 extends it, never
15	/// rebuilds it") extended by spec-8-1 with the "Sua evolução" chart
16	/// section below the toggle. Replaces the former
17	/// `ConfiguracoesPlaceholderScreen`.
18	class AccountSettingsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
19	  const AccountSettingsScreen({
20	    required this.cubit,
21	    required this.dashboardCubit,
22	    super.key,
23	  });
24	
25	  final AccountSettingsCubit cubit;
26	
27	  /// spec-8-1 — the "Sua evolução" chart section's own cubit, a DI
28	  /// `lazySingleton` like [cubit] (Code Map); this `StatefulWidget` never
29	  /// closes it either, same rationale [cubit]'s own doc already gives.
30	  final DashboardCubit dashboardCubit;
31	
32	  @override
33	  State<AccountSettingsScreen> createState() => _AccountSettingsScreenState();
34	}
35	
36	class _AccountSettingsScreenState extends State<AccountSettingsScreen> {
37	  @override
38	  void initState() {
39	    super.initState();
40	    // Review finding: clears a leftover error from a previous visit's
41	    // failed toggle — this cubit is a DI singleton, so without this a
42	    // stale message would still be showing on an unrelated later visit.
43	    widget.cubit.clearStaleError();
44	    // Boundaries: "`AccountSettingsScreen.initState` calls
45	    // `dashboardCubit.load()` unconditionally... so every open is a live
46	    // fetch, never the singleton's stale state" (FR-09: "computed on
47	    // demand, never stale").
48	    widget.dashboardCubit.load();
49	  }
50	
51	  // Review finding: mirrors `vault_lock_screen.dart`'s own `_announce` —
52	  // VoiceOver (this app is iOS-only) doesn't reliably treat a live-region
53	  // subtree update as an announcement on its own, so a failed/reverted
54	  // toggle is spoken explicitly here instead.
55	  Future<void> _announce(String message) async {
56	    if (!mounted) {
57	      return;
58	    }
59	    await SemanticsService.sendAnnouncement(
60	      View.of(context),
61	      message,
62	      TextDirection.ltr,
63	    );
64	  }
65	
66	  @override
67	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
68	    return MultiBlocProvider(
69	      providers: [
70	        BlocProvider.value(value: widget.cubit),
71	        // spec-8-1 — makes `DashboardCubit` available to
72	        // `DashboardChartSection` below, same two-cubit convention
73	        // `MeusRegistrosScreen` already uses for its own `cubit`/
74	        // `searchCubit` pair.
75	        BlocProvider.value(value: widget.dashboardCubit),
76	      ],
77	      child: Scaffold(
78	        backgroundColor: DesignTokens.colorSurfaceBg,
79	        body: Column(
80	          children: [
81	            const BackArrowHeader(title: 'Configurações'),
82	            // spec-8-1 — now `Expanded` + scrollable: the toggle alone
83	            // always fit unscrolled, but the chart section below it can
84	            // grow past the available height on a shorter device/larger
85	            // text scale (Design Notes: "decide and proceed" — neither
86	            // `prototype-extract.md` nor the frozen spec says whether this
87	            // screen scrolls).
88	            Expanded(
89	              child: SingleChildScrollView(
90	                padding: DesignTokens.screenPadding,
91	                child: Column(
92	                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
93	                  children: [
94	                    BlocConsumer<AccountSettingsCubit, AccountSettingsState>(
95	                      listener: (context, state) {
96	                        if (state.errorMessage != null) {
97	                          _announce(state.errorMessage!);
98	                        }
99	                      },
100	                      builder: (context, state) {
101	                        return Column(
102	                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
103	                          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
104	                          children: [
105	                            MergeSemantics(
106	                              child: Semantics(
107	                                label: 'Entrar com biometria',
108	                                child: Row(
109	                                  children: [
110	                                    Expanded(
111	                                      child: ExcludeSemantics(
112	                                        child: Text(
113	                                          'Entrar com biometria',
114	                                          style: DesignTokens.textBodyLg
115	                                              .copyWith(
116	                                                color: DesignTokens
117	                                                    .colorTextPrimary,
118	                                              ),
119	                                        ),
120	                                      ),
121	                                    ),
122	                                    if (state.isSaving) ...[
123	                                      const SizedBox(
124	                                        width: DesignTokens
125	                                            .accountSettingsSavingIndicatorSize,
126	                                        height: DesignTokens
127	                                            .accountSettingsSavingIndicatorSize,
128	                                        child: CircularProgressIndicator(
129	                                          strokeWidth: DesignTokens
130	                                              .accountSettingsSavingIndicatorStrokeWidth,
131	                                          color: DesignTokens.colorAccent,
132	                                        ),
133	                                      ),
134	                                      const SizedBox(
135	                                        width: DesignTokens.spacingSm,
136	                                      ),
137	                                    ],
138	                                    Switch(
139	                                      value: state.biometricEnabled,
140	                                      // Boundaries: "no new tokens" — reuses
141	                                      // `colorAccent` (Design Notes).
142	                                      activeThumbColor:
143	                                          DesignTokens.colorAccent,
144	                                      // Review finding: `null` while a
145	                                      // toggle is already in flight
146	                                      // (`state.isSaving`) — a disabled
147	                                      // `Switch` can't be tapped again, so a
148	                                      // double-tap can never start a
149	                                      // second, overlapping
150	                                      // `toggleBiometric` call.
151	                                      onChanged: state.isSaving
152	                                          ? null
153	                                          : (value) => context
154	                                                .read<AccountSettingsCubit>()
155	                                                .toggleBiometric(value),
156	                                    ),
157	                                  ],
158	                                ),
159	                              ),
160	                            ),
161	                            if (state.errorMessage != null) ...[
162	                              const SizedBox(height: DesignTokens.spacingSm),
163	                              Text(
164	                                state.errorMessage!,
165	                                style: DesignTokens.textBodyMd.copyWith(
166	                                  color: DesignTokens.colorError,
167	                                ),
168	                              ),
169	                            ],
170	                          ],
171	                        );
172	                      },
173	                    ),
174	                    // spec-8-1 — "Sua evolução", sibling to the biometric
175	                    // toggle section above (Code Map: "insert chart as
176	                    // sibling Column child").
177	                    const SizedBox(height: DesignTokens.spacingXl),
178	                    // Review finding: unlike the biometric toggle's own
179	                    // `BlocConsumer` above, the chart section previously
180	                    // never announced its own fetch failures to
181	                    // VoiceOver — a `ResourceError` only ever showed as
182	                    // silent inline text. Reuses the same [_announce]
183	                    // this `State` already uses for the toggle's error,
184	                    // same "VoiceOver doesn't reliably treat a live-region
185	                    // update as an announcement on its own" rationale.
186	                    BlocListener<DashboardCubit, Resource<DashboardAggregate>>(
187	                      listener: (context, state) {
188	                        if (state is ResourceError<DashboardAggregate>) {
189	                          _announce(state.failure.message);
190	                        }
191	                      },
192	                      child: const DashboardChartSection(),
193	                    ),
194	                  ],
195	                ),
196	              ),
197	            ),
198	          ],
199	        ),
200	      ),
201	    );
202	  }
203	}

1	import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
2	import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
3	
4	import '../../../../core/design_tokens.dart';
5	import '../../../../core/resource.dart';
6	import '../../domain/entities/dashboard_aggregate.dart';
7	import '../cubit/dashboard_cubit.dart';
8	
9	/// "Sua evolução" — Story 8.1's own chart section on Configurações
10	/// (`cerne-prototype.html`'s Tela 6 dashboard block). Reads [DashboardCubit]
11	/// via `BlocBuilder` — `AccountSettingsScreen`'s own `MultiBlocProvider`
12	/// already makes it available higher up the tree, same convention
13	/// `MeusRegistrosScreen` already uses for its own two cubits.
14	///
15	/// The AI narrative paragraph is explicitly out of scope here (Story 8.2,
16	/// Intent/Never) — every branch below renders *at most* a short, hardcoded
17	/// Portuguese placeholder message, never anything derived from
18	/// `dashboard-narrative-get`.
19	class DashboardChartSection extends StatelessWidget {
20	  const DashboardChartSection({super.key});
21	
22	  static const _emptyMessage =
23	      'Comece a registrar para ver sua evolução '
24	      'aqui';
25	
26	  static const _oneEntryMessage =
27	      'Ainda é cedo pra ver um padrão — volte '
28	      'em alguns dias.';
29	
30	  /// Boundaries: "`buckets` condensed to exactly 10 bars".
31	  static const _targetCondensedBars = 10;
32	
33	  @override
34	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
35	    return Column(
36	      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
37	      children: [
38	        Text(
39	          'Sua evolução',
40	          style: DesignTokens.textHeadlineMd.copyWith(
41	            color: DesignTokens.colorTextPrimary,
42	          ),
43	        ),
44	        const SizedBox(height: DesignTokens.dashboardSectionGap),
45	        BlocBuilder<DashboardCubit, Resource<DashboardAggregate>>(
46	          builder: (context, state) => _buildBody(state),
47	        ),
48	      ],
49	    );
50	  }
51	
52	  Widget _buildBody(Resource<DashboardAggregate> state) {
53	    return switch (state) {
54	      ResourceIdle<DashboardAggregate>() ||
55	      ResourceLoading<DashboardAggregate>() => _loadingCard(),
56	      ResourceError<DashboardAggregate>(failure: final failure) => _errorCard(
57	        failure.message,
58	      ),
59	      ResourceData<DashboardAggregate>(data: final aggregate) => _populatedCard(
60	        aggregate,
61	      ),
62	    };
63	  }
64	
65	  /// Review finding (round 2): uses [DesignTokens.dashboardCardPadding] —
66	  /// same padding [_populatedCard]'s own card uses — rather than
67	  /// [DesignTokens.spacingLg], so the card doesn't visibly resize on every
68	  /// loading -> data transition (including a background `confirmedWrites`
69	  /// refresh, which never shows this state to begin with but would have on
70	  /// a slow repeated `load()`).
71	  Widget _loadingCard() => _card(
72	    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(DesignTokens.dashboardCardPadding),
73	    child: const Center(
74	      child: CircularProgressIndicator(
75	        color: DesignTokens.colorAccent,
76	        semanticsLabel: 'Carregando gráfico de evolução',
77	      ),
78	    ),
79	  );
80	
81	  /// I/O matrix: "Fetch fails -> ResourceError, inline error text, no
82	  /// crash" — same inline-error treatment `AccountSettingsScreen`'s own
83	  /// biometric-toggle failure already uses ([DesignTokens.textBodyMd] +
84	  /// [DesignTokens.colorError]). Padding matches [_loadingCard]'s own
85	  /// review-fix rationale above.
86	  Widget _errorCard(String message) => _card(
87	    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(DesignTokens.dashboardCardPadding),
88	    child: Text(
89	      message,
90	      style: DesignTokens.textBodyMd.copyWith(color: DesignTokens.colorError),
91	    ),
92	  );
93	
94	  /// I/O matrix: "Zero entries -> icon + 'Comece a registrar...'".
95	  Widget _emptyCard() => _card(
96	    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(DesignTokens.spacingLg),
97	    child: Column(
98	      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
99	      children: [
100	        // Review finding: a bare `Icon` with no `semanticLabel` is simply
101	        // excluded from the semantics tree (Flutter's own default) — a
102	        // screen-reader user hears nothing at all for it, relying entirely
103	        // on the text below. [_emptyMessage]'s own text already reads
104	        // naturally without the icon, so this label is purely additional
105	        // context, never a duplicate announcement of that same text.
106	        const Icon(
107	          Icons.show_chart,
108	          size: DesignTokens.dashboardEmptyStateIconSize,
109	          color: DesignTokens.colorBorder,
110	          semanticLabel: 'Gráfico de evolução vazio',
111	        ),
112	        const SizedBox(height: DesignTokens.dashboardEmptyStateGap),
113	        Text(
114	          _emptyMessage,
115	          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
116	          style: DesignTokens.textLabelMd.copyWith(
117	            color: DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary,
118	          ),
119	        ),
120	      ],
121	    ),
122	  );
123	
124	  /// Boundaries' own count matrix: `0` is [_emptyCard]; `1` is exactly one
125	  /// full-height bar plus [_oneEntryMessage]; `>30` condenses
126	  /// [DashboardAggregate.bucketCounts] to exactly [_targetCondensedBars]
127	  /// bars via [_condense]; `2..30` renders one bar per bucket as-is — the
128	  /// "matrix gap" the frozen spec's own Boundaries line resolves per
129	  /// AGENTS.md's "decide and proceed". None of the non-zero branches ever
130	  /// renders text other than the `1`-count message (Boundaries: "no text").
131	  Widget _populatedCard(DashboardAggregate aggregate) {
132	    final totalCount = aggregate.totalCount;
133	    if (totalCount == 0) {
134	      return _emptyCard();
135	    }
136	
137	    List<int> barCounts;
138	    String? message;
139	    if (totalCount == 1) {
140	      barCounts = const [1];
141	      message = _oneEntryMessage;
142	    } else if (totalCount > 30) {
143	      barCounts = _condense(aggregate.bucketCounts);
144	    } else {
145	      barCounts = aggregate.bucketCounts;
146	    }
147	
148	    var maxCount = barCounts.fold(0, (max, count) => count > max ? count : max);
149	
150	    // Review finding (defensive guard): `totalCount > 0` with every
151	    // `barCounts` entry at 0 (or the list empty) is contract-inconsistent
152	    // (`totals.count` and the sum of every `buckets[].count` should
153	    // always agree) but not impossible against malformed/inconsistent
154	    // backend data — falls back to a single bar for the whole
155	    // [totalCount] rather than silently rendering an invisible bar row
156	    // (RNF09: never a blank/broken-looking screen over bad data). Checked
157	    // via `maxCount == 0` rather than `barCounts.isEmpty` so it also
158	    // catches `_condense`'s output, which is never empty (always exactly
159	    // [_targetCondensedBars] entries) even when every summed chunk is 0.
160	    if (maxCount == 0) {
161	      barCounts = [totalCount];
162	      maxCount = totalCount;
163	    }
164	
165	    return _card(
166	      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(DesignTokens.dashboardCardPadding),
167	      child: Column(
168	        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
169	        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
170	        children: [
171	          // Review finding: each bar is a bare, unlabeled `Container` —
172	          // wrapping the whole row in one summarizing `Semantics` label
173	          // (and excluding the individual bars from the semantics tree)
174	          // gives a screen-reader user one meaningful announcement
175	          // instead of N anonymous elements.
176	          Semantics(
177	            label:
178	                'Gráfico de evolução: $totalCount registros no período, '
179	                'em ${barCounts.length} barras.',
180	            child: ExcludeSemantics(
181	              child: SizedBox(
182	                height: DesignTokens.dashboardBarAreaHeight,
183	                child: Row(
184	                  spacing: DesignTokens.spacingSm,
185	                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
186	                  children: [
187	                    for (final count in barCounts)
188	                      DashboardChartBar(
189	                        // Review finding: clamped here, matching
190	                        // `DashboardChartBar`'s own doc comment — a
191	                        // negative `count` (malformed backend data)
192	                        // would otherwise produce a negative height and
193	                        // crash the `Container` below.
194	                        heightFraction: (count / maxCount).clamp(0, 1),
195	                      ),
196	                  ],
197	                ),
198	              ),
199	            ),
200	          ),
201	          if (message != null) ...[
202	            const SizedBox(height: DesignTokens.dashboardSectionGap),
203	            Text(
204	              message,
205	              style: DesignTokens.textLabelMd.copyWith(
206	                color: DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary,
207	              ),
208	            ),
209	          ],
210	        ],
211	      ),
212	    );
213	  }
214	
215	  /// Boundaries (amended, Spec Change Log): "`bucketCounts` left-padded
216	  /// with leading zero-count entries to length 10 (when shorter) *before*
217	  /// condensing... via 10 contiguous index chunks, summed `count`,
218	  /// remainder in the last chunk". The original, frozen wording degenerated
219	  /// whenever `bucketCounts.length < _targetCondensedBars`: the floor-
220	  /// division chunk size was `0`, so the first 9 chunks each summed an
221	  /// *empty* range (always `0`) and the 10th silently absorbed the entire
222	  /// total — 9 invisible bars + 1 giant one, defeating the chart for any
223	  /// user whose activity concentrates into fewer than 10 distinct backend
224	  /// buckets while still exceeding 30 entries. [_pad] below removes that
225	  /// degeneracy: once [bucketCounts] is at least [_targetCondensedBars]
226	  /// long (real data, or zero-padded), the same "first 9 chunks of
227	  /// `length ~/ 10`, 10th absorbs the remainder" chunking produces a
228	  /// non-degenerate spread — leading zero bars, then the real data at the
229	  /// end, for a short [bucketCounts]. Always exactly [_targetCondensedBars]
230	  /// ints out, regardless of `bucketCounts.length` (I/O matrix: "`>30`
231	  /// entries, any `buckets.length`").
232	  static List<int> _condense(List<int> bucketCounts) {
233	    final padded = _pad(bucketCounts);
234	    final chunkSize = padded.length ~/ _targetCondensedBars;
235	    final condensed = <int>[];
236	    var index = 0;
237	    for (var i = 0; i < _targetCondensedBars - 1; i++) {
238	      final end = index + chunkSize;
239	      condensed.add(_sum(padded, index, end));
240	      index = end;
241	    }
242	    condensed.add(_sum(padded, index, padded.length));
243	    return condensed;
244	  }
245	
246	  /// Left-pads [bucketCounts] with leading zero-count entries up to
247	  /// [_targetCondensedBars] — a no-op once [bucketCounts] already has at
248	  /// least that many entries (Boundaries: "when shorter").
249	  static List<int> _pad(List<int> bucketCounts) {
250	    if (bucketCounts.length >= _targetCondensedBars) {
251	      return bucketCounts;
252	    }
253	    return [
254	      ...List<int>.filled(_targetCondensedBars - bucketCounts.length, 0),
255	      ...bucketCounts,
256	    ];
257	  }
258	
259	  static int _sum(List<int> list, int start, int end) {
260	    var total = 0;
261	    for (var i = start; i < end; i++) {
262	      total += list[i];
263	    }
264	    return total;
265	  }
266	
267	  Widget _card({required EdgeInsets padding, required Widget child}) {
268	    return Container(
269	      padding: padding,
270	      decoration: const BoxDecoration(
271	        color: DesignTokens.colorSurfaceElevated,
272	        borderRadius: BorderRadius.all(Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusMd)),
273	        boxShadow: DesignTokens.elevation1,
274	      ),
275	      child: child,
276	    );
277	  }
278	}
279	
280	/// One chart bar — a `cerne-prototype.html` `chartBars` entry
281	/// (`flex:1;background:#C98A3E;border-radius:4px 4px 0 0`). [heightFraction]
282	/// is `count / maxCount` for whichever bars [DashboardChartSection] is
283	/// currently showing (Boundaries: "Bar height ∝ count / max count shown"),
284	/// clamped to `[0, 1]` by its own caller.
285	class DashboardChartBar extends StatelessWidget {
286	  const DashboardChartBar({required this.heightFraction, super.key});
287	
288	  final double heightFraction;
289	
290	  @override
291	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
292	    return Expanded(
293	      child: Container(
294	        height: DesignTokens.dashboardBarAreaHeight * heightFraction,
295	        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
296	          color: DesignTokens.colorAccent,
297	          borderRadius: BorderRadius.only(
298	            topLeft: Radius.circular(DesignTokens.dashboardBarRadius),
299	            topRight: Radius.circular(DesignTokens.dashboardBarRadius),
300	          ),
301	        ),
302	      ),
303	    );
304	  }
305	}

# Error taxonomy — 13 codes

Every endpoint returns errors as `{ code, message, retryable }`. The list below is closed: no other code exists.

| Code | HTTP | Retryable |
|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_EXPIRED` | 401 | no |
| `AUTH_INVALID` | 401 | no |
| `NETWORK_TIMEOUT` | 504 | yes |
| `NETWORK_OFFLINE` | _(no HTTP response — see note)_ | yes |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | no |
| `PII_CHECK_FAILED` | 502 | yes |
| `EMBEDDING_FAILED` | 502 | yes |
| `AI_GENERATION_TIMEOUT` | 504 | yes |
| `NOT_FOUND` | 404 | no |
| `RATE_LIMITED` | 429 | yes |
| `EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD` | 400 | no |
| `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` | 413 | no |
| `OCR_NO_TEXT` | 400 | no |

**Two deliberate design choices (these never happen in this API):**
- **Never `403`** — a resource belonging to another user always answers `404 NOT_FOUND` (so its existence is not revealed).
- **Never `409`** — the idempotency of RF10 (re-sending the same chat message as an entry) always answers `200`; there is no "conflict" code.

**`NETWORK_OFFLINE` has no HTTP status:** it is the only code that never becomes an actual response — it represents a connection that ends without any response.

1	# Test Automation Summary
2	
3	## Scope
4	
5	Flutter/Dart project — "E2E" here means the project's own established
6	convention of `*_flow_e2e_test.dart` files: the real DI graph (`sl`),
7	real `Cubit` -> `Repository` -> `DataSource` -> `ApiClient` -> `Dio`
8	pipeline (both real interceptors attached), with only the transport
9	boundary (`HttpClientAdapter`) and native plugins faked (no
10	device/simulator/CI exists yet per AGENTS.md). Playwright/browser E2E
11	does not apply to this codebase.
12	
13	Target feature: **export** (story 7.1 — request a period export & job
14	status tracking), chosen because capture, entries, and chat already had
15	this level of coverage; export did not.
16	
17	## Generated Tests
18	
19	### E2E Tests
20	
21	- [x] `test/features/export/export_flow_e2e_test.dart` — 5 tests, driven
22	  directly against the real, DI-resolved `ExportJobCubit`:
23	  - Happy path: `start()` → genuine `export-summary-create` POST (URL,
24	    headers, periodEnd bumped to local end-of-day before UTC
25	    conversion) → real `Timer.periodic` poll loop → genuine
26	    `export-status-get/{jobId}` GETs → Pendente → Processando →
27	    Concluído (`ExportOutcome.narrativeReady`); also asserts polling
28	    really stops once terminal.
29	  - Narrativa falhou: `narrativeStatus: failed` maps to
30	    `ExportOutcome.narrativeUnavailable` through the real DTO mapping.
31	  - Período vazio: `errorCode: EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD` maps through the
32	    real `Failure.fromCode` → `ExportJobState.emptyPeriod()`.
33	  - Erro: a non-empty-period error code (`AI_GENERATION_TIMEOUT`) maps
34	    to the generic `ExportJobState.error`.
35	  - Review-patch coverage: `export-summary-create` failing with a
36	    *retryable* code (`RATE_LIMITED`) is never retried — proves
37	    `RetryInterceptor.neverRetriedFunctions`' real wiring for this
38	    function (previously only exercised in isolation or against a fake
39	    repository, never through the real Dio pipeline).
40	
41	- [x] `test/core/network/api_client_test.dart` / `test/features/export/
42	  export_flow_e2e_test.dart` — closed a test-pinning gap flagged by
43	  spec-7-2's round-2 code review (`deferred-work.md`): the mocked unit
44	  test now captures the `options` argument to `getRedirectLocation`'s
45	  `Dio.get` call and asserts `followRedirects == false` and the
46	  permissive `validateStatus` boundary (302 true / 400 false); the e2e
47	  test now asserts `followRedirects` on the request that actually
48	  reached the fake transport adapter, after passing through the real
49	  header + retry interceptor chain. Previously, flipping or dropping
50	  `followRedirects: false` in `ApiClient.getRedirectLocation` would not
51	  have failed either test.
52	
53	This complements, and does not duplicate, existing coverage:

# Test Automation Summary

## Scope

Flutter/Dart project — "E2E" here means the project's own established
convention of `*_flow_e2e_test.dart` files: the real DI graph (`sl`),
real `Cubit` -> `Repository` -> `DataSource` -> `ApiClient` -> `Dio`
pipeline (both real interceptors attached), with only the transport
boundary (`HttpClientAdapter`) and native plugins faked (no
device/simulator/CI exists yet per AGENTS.md). Playwright/browser E2E
does not apply to this codebase.

Target feature: **export** (story 7.1 — request a period export & job
status tracking), chosen because capture, entries, and chat already had
this level of coverage; export did not.

## Generated Tests

### E2E Tests

- [x] `test/features/export/export_flow_e2e_test.dart` — 5 tests, driven
  directly against the real, DI-resolved `ExportJobCubit`:
  - Happy path: `start()` → genuine `export-summary-create` POST (URL,
    headers, periodEnd bumped to local end-of-day before UTC
    conversion) → real `Timer.periodic` poll loop → genuine
    `export-status-get/{jobId}` GETs → Pendente → Processando →
    Concluído (`ExportOutcome.narrativeReady`); also asserts polling
    really stops once terminal.
  - Narrativa falhou: `narrativeStatus: failed` maps to
    `ExportOutcome.narrativeUnavailable` through the real DTO mapping.
  - Período vazio: `errorCode: EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD` maps through the
    real `Failure.fromCode` → `ExportJobState.emptyPeriod()`.
  - Erro: a non-empty-period error code (`AI_GENERATION_TIMEOUT`) maps
    to the generic `ExportJobState.error`.
  - Review-patch coverage: `export-summary-create` failing with a
    *retryable* code (`RATE_LIMITED`) is never retried — proves
    `RetryInterceptor.neverRetriedFunctions`' real wiring for this
    function (previously only exercised in isolation or against a fake
    repository, never through the real Dio pipeline).

- [x] `test/core/network/api_client_test.dart` / `test/features/export/
  export_flow_e2e_test.dart` — closed a test-pinning gap flagged by
  spec-7-2's round-2 code review (`deferred-work.md`): the mocked unit
  test now captures the `options` argument to `getRedirectLocation`'s
  `Dio.get` call and asserts `followRedirects == false` and the
  permissive `validateStatus` boundary (302 true / 400 false); the e2e
  test now asserts `followRedirects` on the request that actually
  reached the fake transport adapter, after passing through the real
  header + retry interceptor chain. Previously, flipping or dropping
  `followRedirects: false` in `ApiClient.getRedirectLocation` would not
  have failed either test.

This complements, and does not duplicate, existing coverage:
`export_job_cubit_test.dart` (fake repository, I/O-matrix transitions),
`export_remote_data_source_test.dart` (mocked `ApiClient`, DTO
decoding), `export_status_sheet_test.dart` (widget rendering per
state), and `meus_registros_screen_test.dart`'s "export entry point"
group (tap → picker → `start()` → sheet, against a fake repository).
None of those drove a real network/poll round trip end to end.

### API Tests

Not applicable separately — the backend contract is exercised through
the same e2e suite above (real `ApiClient`/`Dio`/interceptors against a
faked transport), consistent with how every other feature in this
project is tested (no standalone HTTP-level test layer exists outside
this pattern).

## Target feature: auth (story 1.3 — account creation & login)

Chosen because capture, entries, chat, and export already had this
level of coverage; auth (and vault) were the two gaps this same file's
own "Next Steps" section previously called out.

- [x] `test/features/auth/auth_flow_e2e_test.dart` — 4 tests, driven
  directly against the real, DI-resolved `AuthCubit`:
  - Happy path (signUp mode): `submit()` → genuine `auth-signup` POST,
    carrying the anon key as *both* `apikey` and the `Authorization`
    bearer (this function has `security: []` in the contract — never a
    user token) → session pair lands in the real
    `flutter_secure_storage` channel via the real `AccessTokenProvider`
    → the real `SessionRepository` singleton's `statusStream` flips to
    `authenticated` *before* `AuthCubit` emits its own success state
    (the story 1.6 `markAuthenticated()`-ordering boundary) → typed
    password cleared.
  - Happy path (login mode): same assertions against `auth-login`.
  - Email trimming: a value with stray leading/trailing whitespace
    reaches the real transport already trimmed.
  - Failure path: a non-retryable `AUTH_INVALID` (401) surfaces as
    `formError` with `Failure.message` verbatim, status returns to
    idle, nothing is written to the real secure-storage channel, and
    `SessionRepository.currentStatus` is never touched.

This complements, and does not duplicate, existing coverage:
`auth_cubit_test.dart` (fake `AuthRepository`/`SessionRepository`),
`auth_repository_impl_test.dart` / `auth_remote_data_source_test.dart`
(mocked `ApiClient`, the 15-scenario write-failure matrix), and
`auth_screen_test.dart` (widget rendering). None of them drove a real
`auth-signup`/`auth-login` POST — built by the real `UrlBuilder`,
carrying the real anon-key-as-bearer header policy — all the way
through to a real secure-storage write and a real
`SessionRepository.statusStream` flip, in one `submit()` call.

### API Tests

Not applicable separately, same rationale as the export entry above —
exercised through the same e2e suite.

## Verification

- `fvm flutter analyze` — 0 issues (project-wide)
- `fvm flutter test` — **1135/1135 passed**, no regressions in the
  existing suite (export's own entry above was last verified at
  1128/1128; the auth additions above account for the +7 difference —
  4 new auth tests plus 3 already added by story 7.3 in between)

## Coverage

- Features with `*_flow_e2e_test.dart` coverage: capture, entries,
  chat, export, **auth** (new)
- Still missing this level of coverage: vault (biometric/PIN gate) —
  already `done`, revisit when its own review cycle comes up. Unlike
  the others, `VaultRepositoryImpl` makes zero network calls
  (Boundaries) and already has very thorough mocked-plugin unit
  coverage in `vault_repository_impl_test.dart` (every I/O-matrix
  branch, including two superseded-call races) — the remaining gap
  there is narrower: proving the real DI-resolved
  `sl<VaultRepository>()` and `sl<AccessTokenProvider>()` share the
  real secure-storage channel without a key collision (`vault_pin` vs.
  `user_access_token`/`user_refresh_token`), which no current test
  exercises end to end.
- Epic 8 (dashboard/profile/logout/account-deletion) is still
  `backlog`, so e2e coverage for it is N/A for now.

## Next Steps

- Consider the same real-pipeline e2e treatment for vault (biometric/
  PIN gate) when its own review cycle comes up — see the narrower gap
  described under Coverage above.
- This entry (story 7.1) predates story 7.2's own e2e additions — the
  `getRedirectLocation` group and the `download` group (`downloadPdf()`/
  `downloadRawData()` through the real DI graph) in the same
  `export_flow_e2e_test.dart`, added across spec-7-2's own commit and
  its code review — have no `Target feature` entry of their own above
  (review finding, code review of spec-7-2, docs/metadata group: this
  file was committed late, as a leftover uncommitted spec-7-1 artifact,
  per spec-7-2's own commit message — nothing has documented 7.2's own
  e2e work here yet).

    round trip through the exact shared `sl<PendingEntryWriteTracker>()`
    singleton confirms a write, and `DashboardCubit`'s own constructor

    calling `load()` a second time. Asserts exactly two

# Test Automation Summary

## Scope

Flutter/Dart project — "E2E" here means the project's own established
convention of `*_flow_e2e_test.dart` files: the real DI graph (`sl`),
real `Cubit` -> `Repository` -> `DataSource` -> `ApiClient` -> `Dio`
pipeline (both real interceptors attached), with only the transport
boundary (`HttpClientAdapter`) and native plugins faked (no
device/simulator/CI exists yet per AGENTS.md). Playwright/browser E2E
does not apply to this codebase.

Target feature: **export** (story 7.1 — request a period export & job
status tracking), chosen because capture, entries, and chat already had
this level of coverage; export did not.

## Generated Tests

### E2E Tests

- [x] `test/features/export/export_flow_e2e_test.dart` — 5 tests, driven
  directly against the real, DI-resolved `ExportJobCubit`:
  - Happy path: `start()` → genuine `export-summary-create` POST (URL,
    headers, periodEnd bumped to local end-of-day before UTC
    conversion) → real `Timer.periodic` poll loop → genuine
    `export-status-get/{jobId}` GETs → Pendente → Processando →
    Concluído (`ExportOutcome.narrativeReady`); also asserts polling
    really stops once terminal.
  - Narrativa falhou: `narrativeStatus: failed` maps to
    `ExportOutcome.narrativeUnavailable` through the real DTO mapping.
  - Período vazio: `errorCode: EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD` maps through the
    real `Failure.fromCode` → `ExportJobState.emptyPeriod()`.
  - Erro: a non-empty-period error code (`AI_GENERATION_TIMEOUT`) maps
    to the generic `ExportJobState.error`.
  - Review-patch coverage: `export-summary-create` failing with a
    *retryable* code (`RATE_LIMITED`) is never retried — proves
    `RetryInterceptor.neverRetriedFunctions`' real wiring for this
    function (previously only exercised in isolation or against a fake
    repository, never through the real Dio pipeline).

- [x] `test/core/network/api_client_test.dart` / `test/features/export/
  export_flow_e2e_test.dart` — closed a test-pinning gap flagged by
  spec-7-2's round-2 code review (`deferred-work.md`): the mocked unit
  test now captures the `options` argument to `getRedirectLocation`'s
  `Dio.get` call and asserts `followRedirects == false` and the

  reached the fake transport adapter, after passing through the real
  header + retry interceptor chain. Previously, flipping or dropping
  `followRedirects: false` in `ApiClient.getRedirectLocation` would not
  have failed either test.

This complements, and does not duplicate, existing coverage:
`export_job_cubit_test.dart` (fake repository, I/O-matrix transitions),

Not applicable separately — the backend contract is exercised through
the same e2e suite above (real `ApiClient`/`Dio`/interceptors against a
faked transport), consistent with how every other feature in this
project is tested (no standalone HTTP-level test layer exists outside
this pattern).
